params.body:
Follow-up to #379 (area: npm/git globals and sandbox types). It covers the items from the review that #380, #381, and #382 don't.

- [ ] `npm.ci({ includeDev? })`: `npm ci` went through `execFile` 4+ times because `npm.install` can't run it.
- [ ] `git.switch` / `git.fetch` / `git.pull` / `git.revParse` / `git.lsRemote` (or `git.run(args)`): about 35 `execFile("git", …)` calls used these.
- [ ] `npm.run(script, options)`: accept options as the second argument, or explain where they go (375#16).
- [ ] `ci.waitForCommit`: give the result a shared `outcome`/`conclusion` field so `.conclusion` type-checks (368#23, 372#69).
- [ ] Waits: on timeout, return `{ outcome: "pending" }` with a hint to call again, instead of throwing (375#19 → 375#20).
- [ ] `workspace.edit`: accept mapped `PitEditChange[]` arrays and plain string anchors, checked at runtime (372#30, 372#31). `workspace.batch` edit items need `changes: { revision, changes }`, which isn't obvious from the docs.
- [ ] Sandbox type definitions: declare `atob`/`btoa`, which exist at runtime but fail type-checking (376#4).
- [ ] Composites: `delivery.openPullRequest` (branch → commit → push → `prCreate`) and `pr.merge({ sync: true })` (merge, then switch to `main` and `pull --ff-only`), each done by hand 4+ times.
